items.title: Payment for private 'land registry' entry offer
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar due date directly ('Zahlbar bis 01.12.2026 ohne Abzug'), so no period calculation or delivery-fiction is needed; the due date is simply the date printed. 01.12.2026 is a Tuesday, a normal business day in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift applies.

warnings: This is very likely a scam/deceptive commercial offer, not an official invoice from a public land registry: the sender name 'Grundstücksregister Online Service GmbH' is designed to look like the official Grundbuch (land register), but it is a private company with no connection to it.

The small print explicitly states: 'Dieses Schreiben ist ein Angebot. Mit Ihrer Zahlung nehmen Sie es an; ein Vertrag kommt erst durch die Zahlung zustande. Die Eintragung erfolgt im privaten Verzeichnis des Absenders und steht in keinem Zusammenhang mit dem amtlichen Grundbuch.' This means it is merely an offer for a worthless private listing, and no contract or payment obligation exists unless the recipient actively chooses to pay for it.
Recommend NOT paying this invoice; registration with the official Grundbuch is handled by the local Amtsgericht/Grundbuchamt and is never billed this way by a private GmbH.
The document contains no legal-remedy instructions (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung), consistent with it being a private commercial offer rather than an official administrative decision.
